# Agentic Intelligence

> Agentic Intelligence builds and scales AI ventures from concept to production. Based in Christchurch, New Zealand.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://agenticintelligence.co.nz/): company overview, products, team, contact

## Products

- [TakeoffQS](https://takeoffqs.com): AI-powered takeoffs from residential PDF plans for material suppliers, residential builders and independent trades
- [Workable](https://workable.co.nz): AI voice agent for frontline H&S reporting — workers report by phone, in any language
- [Adiso](https://adiso.co.nz): The AI Operating System for Financial Advice — automates admin, supports compliance, captures advice reasoning
- [BuildFoundry](https://buildfoundry.co.nz): AI-powered construction platform covering feasibility through handover
- [xOS](https://xos.co.nz): AI-native sales enablement system unifying CRM, coaching, knowledge, workflows and market intelligence
- Camba: AI-first CRM for New Zealand vehicle dealers (coming soon)
- TrafficSense: AI-powered Traffic Management Plan authoring platform (coming soon)
